reading.title: Shape Hunt
reading.text: We go on a shape hunt at school. I find a circle clock and a square window. My friend finds a triangle sign and a rectangle door. In the toy box, we see a cube, a sphere, and a cone. Learning shapes is fun.
reading.imageBrief: School shape-hunt scene with familiar objects matching the reading.

usage.goal: Recognize more advanced shapes, lines, and angle words in simple visual contexts.
usage.canDoStatement: I can notice basic line and angle words and a few new shapes.

scenes.scenario: The glass block is a prism, the box is a cuboid, and the bowl is a hemisphere.
scenes.imageBrief: Display of a prism, cuboid box, and hemisphere bowl with simple visual clarity.

scenes.imageBrief: Visual card showing obtuse angle, parallel lines like train tracks, and perpendicular wall-floor lines.

reading.title: In the Math Corner
reading.text: In the math corner, we look at shapes and lines. The teacher shows a cuboid box and a hemisphere bowl. Then she draws a straight line, a curve, and a zigzag. We look at a right angle on the board and parallel lines on the floor tiles.
reading.imageBrief: Math-corner classroom scene with a box, bowl, board lines, and floor tiles.

usage.goal: Recognize a few basic geometry and pattern words in highly visual, beginner-friendly contexts.
usage.canDoStatement: I can understand some simple geometry and pattern words when I see them.

scenes.scenario: Area is the space inside a shape, perimeter is the line around it, and volume is the space inside a 3D shape.

check.question: What is the line around a shape?

scenes.imageBrief: Three simple concept cards explaining area, perimeter, and volume with one friendly visual example each.

scenes.scenario: In a circle, the radius goes from the center to the side, the diameter goes across, and the circumference is the line around the circle.

check.question: Which line goes across the circle?

scenes.imageBrief: Beginner-friendly circle diagram showing radius, diameter, and circumference clearly.

scenes.scenario: The square has a diagonal line, the butterfly has symmetry, and the triangle has a vertex at the top.

scenes.scenario: The cube has edges, the drum beat can repeat, and the cards show a sequence.

scenes.scenario: The tiles make a pattern, the wall shows a tessellation, and the tree picture looks like a fractal.
scenes.imageBrief: Pattern-focused scene with floor tiles, tessellation wall design, and a branching tree image suggesting a fractal.

reading.title: Patterns in the Room
reading.text: Our teacher shows us shapes in a new way. We look at the radius and diameter of a big circle. Then we find symmetry in a butterfly picture and a diagonal in a square. On the wall, we see a tile pattern that looks like a tessellation.
reading.imageBrief: Classroom or art-room scene with a big circle diagram, butterfly picture, square, and patterned wall tiles.
